title.value: Evaluation of a web-based tool for labelling potential hospital outbreaks: a mixed methods study
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Evaluation of a web-based tool for labelling potential hospital outbreaks: a mixed methods study

analysis.description: The paper evaluates the usability of a web-based tool by infection control practitioners, specifically for labelling potential outbreaks in hospital settings. The study involved 25 experts using this tool to review incidence time series from various micro-organisms and included a mixed methods research design.

type.justification: The paper involves the evaluation of a web-based tool through practical application and analysis, indicating empirical research.
type.quote: A mixed methods design was used to evaluate how 25 experts from France and Canada interacted with a web-based application to identify potential outbreaks.

name.justification: The paper evaluates a software tool designed for medical data analysis and outbreak detection, which falls under medical informatics.
name.quote: Background: Labelling outbreaks in surveillance data is necessary to train advanced analytical methods for outbreak detection, but there is a lack of software tools dedicated to this task.

name.justification: The study involves outbreak detection and control, which are core components of epidemiology.
name.quote: Aim: To evaluate the usability of a web-based tool by infection control practitioners for labelling potential outbreaks.
